clips.title: The story
paras: Denalan is an accomplished night elf herbalist and botanist who tends a quiet lakeside plot along the eastern shore of Lake Al'Ameth. Working under a simple awning, he devotes his days to studying the island's plant life and seeking botanical remedies for the strange corruption affecting Teldrassil. He frequently enlists young adventurers to gather samples, study violent timberlings, and test enchanted soils.

While many kaldorei focus on martial vigilance or high druidic rites, Denalan pursues the patient, meticulous craft of herbalism. Stationed along the tranquil eastern banks of Lake Al'Ameth, he has established a modest research camp consisting of a cloth awning, simple field tools, and tidy rows of cultivated planter boxes. Rather than retreating to the grand barrows of Darnassus, he prefers to remain close to the loam, directly examining the unusual flora that has sprouted since the planting of the new World Tree.
